main.description: An organization's self-published profile: who it is, what it does, and where it sits. Published in the organization's own repo, so an AppView learns geography from the network rather than inventing it. Nothing here is committed to by any release — it is descriptive, self-asserted, and not part of the 8130 field set. SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA — every organization, CAGE code and certificate here is fictional.

kind.description: What role this organization plays. Self-asserted: nobody validates it, and an AppView is free to disagree.

synthetic.description: Required marker. This record set exists to demonstrate a protocol, not to describe real companies.

cage.description: Fictional commercial identifier. Deliberately formatted so it cannot collide with a real five-character CAGE code.

certificate.description: Fictional repair-station certificate number, where the kind implies one.

latMicro.description: Latitude in microdegrees. An integer because DAG-CBOR under AT Protocol forbids floats outright — the same reason money in this project is counted in cents.
